Zoom from 25 to 500%, Move X and Move Y, or drag and pinch in the plate's preview.
Rotation from −180° to 180°, and Brightness from 0 to 200% to match the screen to the lighting.
Quick fixes for images that arrive sideways or mirrored.
The color shown in the parts of the screen the image doesn't cover, for example with Fit.
Reset restores the image's default placement, Replace picks another image and Remove clears the plate.
Images follow the orientation saved in the file, as they do on the board.

tips: Use screenshots at the device's native resolution and Fill, so nothing stretches.
Lower Brightness slightly under dramatic lighting so the screen doesn't look pasted on.
When you build your own model, set each image slot's Shape so images fill it the right way.
Use Fit with a Backdrop color that matches your app's background for screens with a different aspect ratio.

features.title: 모델에 이미지 슬롯 추가하기
features.summary: 모델의 어느 면에 이미지를 넣을지 선택하여 스크린샷이 해당 프레임 안에 들어가도록 합니다.
steps: 3D 앱에서 해당 면에 별도의 재질을 지정하고 이름을 Screen 또는 Display로 지정합니다. Mica가 자동으로 찾습니다.
또는 모델 페이지에서 모델 세부사항을 열고 원하는 재질의 이미지 슬롯을 켭니다.
이미지가 올바른 방향으로 채워지도록 전화기 또는 와이드 같은 슬롯 모양을 선택합니다.
Model Studio에서 이미지를 슬롯에 드롭합니다. 이미지는 해당 면 안에 머뭅니다.

faq.q: STL 파일에 이미지 슬롯을 만들 수 없는 이유는 무엇입니까?
faq.a: STL 및 PLY 파일에는 재질이 없습니다. 이름이 지정된 재질과 함께 모델을 USDZ로 내보내십시오.
모델 옆의 .mica-model.json 파일에 저장되며, 이 파일로 제목과 마감도 설정할 수 있습니다.

features.why: Image slots tell Mica which surface of a 3D model shows an image, such as a device screen or a poster frame. Your screenshots then land only on that surface, at the right aspect ratio, instead of wrapping the whole model.
uses: Put app screenshots on the screen of your own phone or laptop model.
Show artwork on a picture frame, sign or packaging model.
Give a model several slots, such as front and back displays.
Fix a model whose screen wasn't detected automatically.

details.text: Materials named Screen or Display (for example Screen_Front or Display 2) become image slots automatically.

From a model's menu on the Models page. Lists the model's materials, each with an Image Slot toggle, a Plate Title and a Shape. Find Slots Automatically clears your choices and goes back to name detection.
Any Shape, Phone (9:19.5), Tablet (3:4), Square (1:1), Wide (16:9), Tall (9:16) or Laptop (16:10), so images fill the slot the right way round.
Each slot gets its own plate. Drop an image on the model or a plate, or tap a board image to fill the next open plate. The image stays inside that surface and can be fit, zoomed, moved and rotated.

USDZ (recommended), USD, OBJ and SceneKit files carry named materials, so they support slots. STL and PLY have no materials and no image slots. Supported Formats and Image Slots on the Models page explains each format and how to convert others.
Slot choices, the model's title and finishes are saved in <model name>.mica-model.json beside the model. Every field is optional.
Bringing in your own models, the Models library and Model Studio from it are Mica Pro features. Not available on Apple Vision Pro.

tips: Give each screen its own material in your 3D app and name it Screen; it saves setup in Mica.
Give the slot surface UV coordinates that cover 0 to 1, upright, so images map edge to edge.
Set the slot Shape to match your screenshots' aspect ratio.
Export as USDZ for the most reliable materials and slots.
Name plates clearly, such as Front Screen and Back Screen, when a model has several slots.

features.title: 기기 목업
features.summary: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Android 휴대폰, 브라우저 윈도우의 편집 가능한 벡터 목업을 삽입합니다.
steps: 디자인 도구 → 삽입 → 기기 목업…을 선택합니다.
기기와 다크 또는 라이트 마감을 고릅니다.
디자인을 화면 프레임에 놓으면 화면 모양에 맞게 잘립니다.
베젤과 세부 요소는 다른 벡터 레이어처럼 편집합니다.

faq.a: 목업은 보드 위의 평면적이고 편집 가능한 벡터입니다. 모델 스튜디오는 3D 모델을 이미지로 렌더링합니다.
예. 목업은 프레임이므로 크기를 조절하면 콘텐츠가 제약 조건에 따라 반응합니다.

features.why: Sometimes you need a quick device frame you can edit, not a 3D render. Device mockups are flat vector frames with a clipping screen, so your design stays live and editable inside them.
uses: Frame a live app screen in an iPhone for a review board.
Show a website design inside a Browser Window.
Build a lineup of iPhone, iPad and Mac for a responsive design presentation.
Recolor a mockup's bezel to match a brand color.

details.text: Under Design Tools → Insert. The mockup is placed in the center of the view and selected.

iPhone 17 Pro (402 × 874 screen), iPhone 17 Pro Max (440 × 956), iPhone SE (375 × 667), Android Phone (412 × 915), iPad Pro 11-inch (834 × 1,210), iPad Pro 13-inch (1,032 × 1,376), MacBook Air 13-inch (1,470 × 956), Apple Watch 46mm (208 × 248) and Browser Window (1,440 × 900). Screen sizes are in points.
Dark or Light. The Screen frame starts black for Dark and white for Light.

A container frame holding a clipping Screen frame under a vector Bezel, plus details such as Dynamic Island, Camera, Notch, Home Button, Digital Crown, Window Button and Base. Every part is an editable layer.
A mockup's layers count toward the free plan's layer limit.

tips: Drop a frame of your design into Screen, not an export, so it stays live while you work.
Use Model Studio instead when you need a photographic, angled render.
Resize the whole mockup from its container frame; its contents follow their constraints.
Combine a mockup with a mirror of your design so the device always shows the latest version.

features.title: 빠른 이미지 내보내기
features.summary: 선택한 레이어, 프레임 또는 그룹을 이미지로 렌더링한 다음 복사하거나 드래그하여 내보냅니다.
steps: 레이어, 프레임 또는 그룹을 선택합니다.
속성 하단에서 빠른 이미지 내보내기를 엽니다.
너비와 높이를 설정하거나 1x에서 4x 사이의 배율을 설정합니다.
선택 항목만 렌더링하려면 겹치는 레이어 무시를 켭니다.
복사를 선택하거나 미리보기를 다른 앱으로 드래그합니다.

faq.a: 레이어가 늘어나지 않고 투명한 여백과 함께 가운데에 배치됩니다.
예. 설정 → 데이터 → 빠른 이미지 내보내기에서 기본 배율과 겹침 옵션을 설정합니다.

features.why: Sometimes you need one layer as an image right now, not a full export setup. Quick Image Export renders the selected layer, frame or group in the inspector so you can copy it or drag it straight into another app.
uses: Drag a finished frame into a message or a design review thread.
Copy a logo at 3x to paste into a slide deck.
Render a group at an exact pixel size for a web page or store listing.
Grab one card from a crowded frame without the layers that overlap it.

details.text: A collapsible panel at the bottom of Properties. With nothing selected it asks you to select a layer. It renders only the selected layer, frame or group, with its own shadows and effects.
Output width and height in pixels. Turn on Lock aspect ratio to keep proportions. If the size is a different shape from the layer, the layer is centered with transparent margins and isn't stretched.
1x, 2x, 3x or 4x of the layer's size. Typing a custom width or height replaces the scale.
On: renders the selection alone. Off: layers covering it appear too, cropped to its bounds. Off by default.
Renders the preview and shows its size in pixels. Drag the preview into another app as a PNG, or choose Copy.
Up to 16,384 pixels a side and 40 million pixels in all.
Settings → Data → Quick Image Export sets the starting scale (1x by default) and Ignore Overlapping Layers. Changes made in the panel don't change these defaults.
Quick Image Export, like every export in Mica, needs Mica Pro.

tips: Use Quick Image Export for one-off images, and per-layer Export settings for sizes you repeat.
Turn on Ignore Overlapping Layers when stickies or comments sit over the layer you want.
Type an exact width for store or web assets; the height follows when the aspect ratio is locked.
Set the default scale to 2x in Settings → Data if you mostly export for Retina screens.

features.title: 레이어별 내보내기 설정
features.summary: 레이어에 크기, 접미사, 형식을 지정하여 내보내기 대상으로 표시한 다음 한 번에 모두 내보냅니다.
steps: 레이어를 선택하고 내보내기 섹션에서 +를 클릭합니다.
크기(예: 2x, 0.5x, 512w 또는 64h), 접미사, 형식(PNG, JPEG, SVG 또는 PDF)을 설정합니다.
이 레이어를 내보내려면 내보내기를 선택하고, 페이지에서 표시된 모든 레이어를 내보내려면 ⇧⌘E를 누릅니다.
결과를 파일에 저장하거나 공유합니다.

faq.a: 예. JPEG는 흰색 배경을 사용합니다.

faq.q: 한 레이어에 크기를 몇 개까지 지정할 수 있습니까?
faq.a: 내보내기 행을 최대 16개까지 추가할 수 있습니다.

features.why: Design work often needs the same layers in several sizes and formats, again and again. Export settings live on each layer, so you set them once and export every marked layer in one step.
uses: Export an app icon at 1x, 2x and 3x with @2x and @3x suffixes.
Hand off icons and illustrations as SVG with live text and vector shapes.
Save a poster frame as a vector PDF with embedded fonts for print.
Export every marked frame on a page at once after a round of changes.

details.text: In the inspector of every layer. Choose + to add a row. New rows step 1x, then 2x with @2x, then 3x with @3x. Up to 16 rows per layer, and each change can be undone.
A scale such as 2x or 0.5x (0.1x to 8x), a width such as 512w, or a height such as 64h. Results are limited to 16,384 pixels a side and 40 million pixels.
Added to the layer name, for example @2x. Up to 40 characters; slashes and colons are removed.
PNG keeps transparency. JPEG uses a white background. SVG keeps frames, shapes and text as vectors and embeds other layers as images. PDF keeps shapes, text and images as vectors with fonts embedded.

Blurs, noise, shadows, studio effects and outlines can't be described as PDF or SVG vectors, so they are drawn as high-resolution images for that layer only. The export sheet lists them under Drawn as Images.
A toggle in the export sheet. It writes text as glyph paths, so it looks the same without its fonts but can no longer be edited as text. It's a preference on this device.
Exports every layer on the page that has export rows. Also in Quick Actions and in Export → Selection.

Opens from Share and from Export with the same options. Use each layer's export settings or choose for this export, write One per Layer or One Combined Image, and turn individual layers on or off. Then share separate files, Share as ZIP, Save to Files, or copy up to 20 PNG or JPEG images.
The selection's Export section shows rows every selected layer shares; editing a row changes all of them in one undo step. Export Options… opens the full sheet.
Layer export and sharing need Mica Pro.

tips: Mark layers once with their sizes and formats, then use ⇧⌘E after every change.
Use width (512w) or height (64h) sizes when the target asks for exact pixels, not a scale.
Choose PDF for print: text stays live and fonts are embedded.
Check the Drawn as Images list before handing off vectors, and remove effects that must stay editable.
Turn on Outline SVG Text when the receiver may not have your fonts.

features.title: App Store 스크린샷 내보내기
features.summary: 스크린샷 템플릿을 채우고 App Store에 바로 올릴 수 있는 정확한 크기의 PNG로 내보냅니다.
steps: App Store 스크린샷 세트 또는 Apple 스크린샷 쇼케이스로 보드를 만듭니다.
프레임을 선택하고 스크린샷 콘텐츠를 사용하여 헤드라인, 부제, 스크린샷을 교체합니다.
내보내기 메뉴나 프레임 인스펙터에서 스크린샷 내보내기를 선택합니다.
프레임을 최대 10개까지 고릅니다. Mica가 크기, 필수 필드, 텍스트 맞춤을 확인한 다음 프레임마다 불투명한 PNG를 하나씩 만듭니다.

faq.a: 스크린샷 같은 필수 필드가 아직 비어 있거나 텍스트가 맞지 않기 때문입니다.
아니요. App Store 스크린샷은 불투명해야 하므로 투명한 아트워크는 흰색 위에 배치됩니다.

features.why: App Store Connect accepts screenshots only at exact pixel sizes, without transparency. Screenshot export checks each frame and writes App Store-ready PNGs, so uploads aren't rejected.
uses: Build all ten screenshots for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro on one board.
Refresh a localized set by replacing headlines and screenshots, then export again.
Export one device's row as a numbered set in App Store order.

details.text: A template with one All Devices page: a row of 10 empty frames for each device, at Apple's sizes. iPhone 1320 × 2868, iPad 2064 × 2752, iPhone Duo 2007 × 2853, Apple Vision Pro 3840 × 2160 and Mac 2880 × 1800. Each row is its own layer.
Each showcase frame sits inside a thin, locked grey outline. The outline isn't part of the frame, so it never appears in an export.
In the frame inspector. Replace headline and subtitle text, import a PNG or JPEG up to 50 MB, or reuse an image on the page. Images are cropped from the center, never stretched.
In the board's Export menu and the frame inspector. Choose 1 to 10 visible frames on the current page.
Frames are listed in reading order: rows top to bottom, each row left to right. File names follow that order.

Whole-pixel sizes from 16 to 8,192 per side and at most 20 megapixels per frame, required fields filled, text that fits, and available originals. Video, animation, PDF, link and file content is refused.
One opaque sRGB PNG per frame at its exact size, in a ZIP with a manifest of sizes and checksums. Transparent areas are placed on white. Save to Files or share.
Templates and Export Screenshots need Mica Pro.

tips: Keep each device's 10 frames in one row so the export order matches App Store order.
Use real captures at the device's aspect ratio so nothing is cropped.
Fix every warning in Screenshot Content before you export; a frame with an empty required field is refused.
Export one device at a time and upload that set to its matching display size.

features.title: 페이지, PDF 및 원본 내보내기
features.summary: 선택 영역, 페이지, 저장 영역 또는 보드 전체를 PNG, JPEG, PDF 또는 SVG로 내보내거나 원본 파일을 공유합니다.
steps: 보드의 내보내기 메뉴를 열고 출판용으로 내보내기…를 선택합니다.
범위로 선택 영역, 페이지, 저장 영역, 모든 영역 또는 전체 보드를 선택합니다.
형식과 배경을 고르고 메모, 태그, 소스 링크를 포함할지 선택합니다.
빠르게 내보내려면 같은 메뉴에서 페이지를 PNG로 내보내기…, 페이지를 PDF로 내보내기… 또는 페이지 레퍼런스를 ZIP으로 압축…을 사용합니다.

faq.a: 기본적으로는 내보내지지 않습니다. Mica의 잠금을 해제하고 비공개 콘텐츠 포함을 켜야 합니다.
예. 설정 → 데이터에서 내보낼 때 메타데이터 제거를 켭니다.

features.why: Different people need different files: a client wants a PDF, a website wants JPEGs, an archive wants the original files. Publication Export makes all of them from a selection, page, saved region or the whole board.
uses: Send a client review PDF with notes included.
Export a page as web-sized JPEGs.
Zip the original reference files from a page with a readable manifest.
Print a board region at 300 dpi in Display P3.

details.text: Selection, Current Page, Saved Region, All Saved Regions or Whole Board.

Quick Share (PNG, 2,048 px long edge), Client Review (PDF with notes), Print (PDF, 300 dpi, Display P3), Web (JPEG, 2,560 px), Source Package (Source ZIP) and Data Interchange (Public JSON). A preset never turns on hidden or private content.
PNG, JPEG, PDF, Hybrid SVG, Markdown Package, CSV, Public JSON, Source Folder or Source ZIP. Each format shows a one-line note about what it keeps.
For image formats, Long edge sets the size from 512 to 16,384 px in 512 px steps. JPEG adds JPEG Quality and a Background: White, Black or Board.
Include Notes, Include Tags, Include Source URLs, Include Creator and License, and Include Original Filenames. Source packages also offer Include Mica Application IDs, off by default.
Source formats can include the original files. They may contain EXIF, GPS or other metadata, so leave it off for a privacy-scrubbed package.
Include Hidden Content and Include Private Content are available only after you unlock Mica. Public exports leave them out by default.
Export Page as PNG…, Export Page as PDF…, Zip Page References…, Export Selected Layers…, Export Marked Layers… and Zip Selected References…. On Mac, File → Publication Export… also opens the sheet.
Every export and sharing from Mica needs Mica Pro.

tips: Start from a preset, then adjust; switching presets resets format and options.
Save regions for views you export often, then export All Saved Regions in one go.
Leave Include Original Files off when you share outside your team.
Use Source ZIP to hand references to a collaborator who doesn't use Mica, and .refboard for one who does.

features.title: .refboard 아카이브
features.summary: .refboard 파일에는 페이지, 레이어, 설정, 원본 파일 등 보드 전체가 담겨 있습니다. 백업하거나 공유할 때 사용합니다.
steps: 보드의 내보내기 메뉴를 열고 보드 내보내기…를 선택하거나, 한 페이지만 내보내려면 페이지 내보내기…를 선택합니다.
.refboard 파일을 저장하거나 보냅니다.
파일을 열려면 라이브러리에서 보드 가져오기…를 선택하거나 Mica로 파일을 엽니다.
Mica가 새 보드로 가져오며, 이미 있는 원본은 다시 사용합니다.

faq.a: 예. 프레임, 슈퍼 레이아웃, 컴포넌트, 효과, 미러, 화살표, 텍스트 스타일이 모두 아카이브에 포함됩니다.

faq.q: 이전 버전의 Mica에서 새 아카이브를 열 수 있습니까?
faq.a: 항상 그렇지는 않습니다. 새 아카이브를 열려면 최신 Mica가 필요할 수 있습니다. 새 버전에서는 이전 아카이브를 열 수 있습니다.

features.why: A .refboard file is the only export that holds a board exactly as it is in Mica. Use it to back up a board, move it to another library, or give it to someone else who uses Mica.
uses: Back up a finished project outside iCloud.
Send a board to a collaborator who will keep editing it.
Share one page as its own board.
Export several boards from the library at once.

details.text: In the board's Export menu, the library board menu, and on Mac the File menu. Writes the whole board, with every page, layer, setting and original file.
Writes only the current page as a one-page board.
Exporting several boards from the library writes one .refboard file per board. You can import them together.
In the library's create menu, or open a .refboard file with Mica. Each file becomes a new board with new identities, and originals you already have are reused instead of copied.
Mica never imports part of a board. If your plan has no room for the board or all of its items, the import stops before anything changes.
Newer Mica versions open older archives. An archive from a newer version asks you to update Mica.
If the board, a page or a layer is private, unlock Mica before exporting the archive.
Exporting, sharing and importing .refboard files need Mica Pro.

tips: Export a .refboard before large restructures, as a backup you can import later.
Wait for iCloud to finish downloading originals before exporting; Mica refuses to export a board with missing originals.
Use Export Page… to share only part of a large board.
Use .refboard for anyone on Mica; use Publication Export for everyone else.

features.title: 프로토타입
features.summary: 탭, 호버, 타이머로 프레임을 연결하고, 재생하고, 클릭 가능한 HTML 프로토타입으로 내보냅니다.
steps: 레이어를 선택하고 세부 정보 → 프로토타입을 엽니다.
인터랙션(탭할 때, 호버하는 동안 또는 지연 후)과 이동, 오버레이 열기 같은 동작을 추가합니다.
디졸브, 슬라이드, 푸시, 스마트 애니메이트 같은 전환을 고르고 지속 시간과 이징을 설정합니다.
⌥⌘Return을 눌러 재생합니다. 플레이어에서 독립 실행형 HTML 파일로 내보낼 수 있습니다.

faq.a: 아니요. 모든 브라우저에서 오프라인으로 작동합니다.
예. 전환 스타일로 저장하여 다른 동작에 적용합니다.

features.why: A static frame doesn't show how an app moves from screen to screen. Prototypes let you link frames, play the flow, and share a clickable HTML file anyone can open.
uses: Click through an onboarding flow before building it.
Show a dropdown or sheet as an overlay on top of a screen.
Send a stakeholder a clickable HTML prototype that works offline.
Auto-advance a splash screen with After Delay.

details.text: On Tap, While Hovering or After Delay. After Delay waits 0 to 60 seconds (1 by default).
Navigate To, Open Overlay, Close Overlay, Back or Open Link. One interaction can run several actions in order. Destinations can be frames on any page.
Instant, Dissolve, Slide In from Right, Left, Bottom or Top, Push Left, Right, Up or Down, and Smart Animate. Dissolve is the default.
Duration from 0.05 to 3 seconds (0.3 by default). Easing: Linear, Ease In, Ease Out, Ease In and Out or Spring; Ease Out is the default.
Save as Transition Style… stores a transition with the board so you can apply it to other actions. Delete Style removes one.
On a top-level frame, starts a named flow. Play starts from the selection's frame, a flow start, or the first frame.
Opens the player with Back, Restart and Show Hotspots. Smart Animate animates layers that share a name between frames.
From the player. One self-contained file with up to 80 reachable frames, hotspots, overlays, delays and transitions; Smart Animate falls back to Dissolve. Works offline. Needs Mica Pro.

tips: Give matching layers the same name on both frames so Smart Animate can move them.
Save your standard push and dissolve as transition styles to keep timing consistent.
Set a Flow Starting Point on each entry screen so testers start in the right place.
Use Show Hotspots in the player to check that every tappable area is linked.

features.title: 코멘트, 검사 및 사전 점검
features.summary: 코멘트를 고정하고, 측정값과 손쉬운 사용 정보를 검사하고, 디자인을 전달하기 전에 점검합니다.
steps: C를 누르고 원하는 곳을 클릭하면 그 아래의 레이어에 코멘트가 고정됩니다. 스레드에서 답장하거나 해결합니다.
⌥⇧⌘C를 누르면 모든 코멘트 목록이 표시되며, 목록을 리뷰 PDF로 내보낼 수 있습니다.
세부 정보 → 검사를 열면 측정값, 색상, 타이포그래피, 손쉬운 사용 태그를 볼 수 있습니다.
⌥⇧⌘P를 누르면 디자인 사전 점검이 실행되어 누락된 이미지 및 서체, 넘침, 대비, 레이블을 확인합니다. 수정 또는 모두 수정을 사용합니다.

faq.a: 메모 탭 → 손쉬운 사용에서 역할, 레이블, 힌트를 추가합니다.
예. 레이어에 연결된 핀은 레이어와 함께 이동합니다.

features.why: Handoff goes better when feedback and specs live on the design itself. Comments, Inspect and Design Preflight let you collect notes, read exact values and catch problems before someone else finds them.
uses: Collect feedback from a review and export it as one PDF.
Read spacing, colors and type for a developer, with SwiftUI and CSS code.
Check contrast and missing accessibility labels before handoff.
Find missing fonts and images after importing a board.

details.text: Click anywhere to pin a comment to the layer underneath, so it follows that layer. Threads support replies, edit, delete and resolve, all undoable.
Lists every comment by page. Set Your Name for new comments, turn on Show Resolved, and use Share Review PDF for pages with numbered pins followed by the threads.
In Details. Shows measurements relative to the parent, colors named by variable or style, typography, accessibility tags, and generated SwiftUI and CSS. Read-only.
In the Notes tab: role (such as button, link, image or heading), label and hint. Instances use their main component's tags.
Checks missing images and fonts, text overflow, WCAG AA contrast, detached styles, off-pixel frames and shapes, and missing accessibility labels. Scope: This Page or All Pages.
Repair fonts (system fallback), overflow (auto height), detached styles (reapply) and off-pixel geometry (round), as one undo step. Show on Canvas reveals an issue.
Exporting the review PDF needs Mica Pro.

tips: Pin comments on the layer they're about, not on empty canvas, so they move with it.
Resolve comments instead of deleting them to keep a record of decisions.
Run Preflight on All Pages before every handoff.
Add accessibility labels as you design; Preflight lists every one that's missing.

features.title: AI로 이름 변경
features.summary: 기기에서 레이어의 내용을 바탕으로 이름을 지정합니다. 계정, 네트워크, 추가 다운로드가 필요 없습니다.
steps: 하나 이상의 레이어나 그룹을 선택합니다.
레이어 패널이나 캔버스에서 오른쪽 클릭하고 AI로 이름 변경을 선택합니다.
이름이 하나씩 지정됩니다. 이름을 지정 중인 행에는 진행 표시기가, 대기 중인 행에는 반짝이 아이콘이 표시됩니다.
중단하려면 AI 이름 변경 취소를 선택하고, 이름 변경 전체를 실행 취소하려면 ⌘Z를 누릅니다.

faq.a: 아니요. 사용 가능한 경우 Apple의 온디바이스 모델을 사용하고, 그렇지 않으면 기기 내 규칙을 사용합니다.
아니요. 잠긴 레이어, 잠긴 프레임이나 페이지 안의 레이어, 읽기 전용 보드는 건너뜁니다.

features.why: Layer names like Rectangle 12 make files hard to read and hand off. Rename with AI looks at each layer and its surroundings and gives it a short, useful name, on your device.
uses: Clean up names in an imported or quickly built screen before handoff.
Name dozens of icons and buttons from what they show.
Get layer names in your own language.

details.text: In the Layers panel right-click menu and the canvas selection menu. Each layer is named from its content (kind, text, fill, image) and its parent and siblings. A label or heading keeps its own text.

Uses Apple Intelligence's on-device model, with the layer's image where supported. If it is unavailable, off or doesn't support your language, Mica uses on-device rule-based names and the menu says so. No account or network.
Renames run one at a time. The row being named shows a spinner; waiting rows show a sparkle. A layer is never queued twice.
Appears in both menus while a rename runs. Closing the board also cancels it.
Each command is one undo step that restores the exact previous names. Undoing mid-run stops the rest of the run.
Locked layers, layers in locked groups, frames, layers or pages, and read-only boards are skipped.
Names come back in the app's language.
Rename with AI needs Mica Pro.

tips: Set the length and format you want in Settings → Canvas → AI Layer Names before a big rename.
Lock layers whose names you want to keep; renames skip them.
Rename a whole frame with AI Nested Rename instead of selecting every layer.
Review and fix names by hand afterwards; hand edits are never overwritten by a later undo.

hero.alt: Layer names before and after Rename with AI on Mac

features.title: AI로 중첩 이름 변경
features.summary: 프레임이나 그룹과 그 안의 모든 항목에 이름을 지정하여, 각 이름이 상위 항목 및 같은 단계의 항목과 어울리게 합니다.
steps: 프레임이나 그룹을 선택합니다.
오른쪽 클릭하고 AI로 중첩 이름 변경을 선택합니다.
Mica가 안쪽 레이어의 이름을 먼저 지정한 다음, 각 컨테이너의 이름을 내용에 따라 지정합니다.
실행 취소하면 이전 이름이 한 번에 모두 복원됩니다.

faq.a: 이번 실행에서 이름을 변경하는 레이어만 덮어씁니다. 그 이후에 편집한 이름은 그대로 유지됩니다.

faq.q: 여러 이름 변경을 대기열에 넣을 수 있습니까?
faq.a: 예. 순서대로 하나씩 실행됩니다.

features.why: A container's best name depends on what's inside it. AI Nested Rename names the inside first, then each container from its new contents, so the whole tree reads well.
uses: Name a full app screen, from buttons up to sections and the frame itself.
Tidy a deeply nested component before publishing it.
Make an imported design readable in the Layers panel in one step.

details.text: On a frame or group in the Layers panel menu, and in the canvas menu when the selection includes one.
Walks the tree in Layers panel order and names each container after its contents, so containers see their children's new names and every inner layer sees its parent and siblings.
Uses the Name Length, Name Format and Naming Rules from Settings → Canvas → AI Layer Names.
One undo step restores every previous name. Locked layers and read-only boards are skipped.
Several renames run one at a time, in order. Cancel AI Rename stops them.
AI Nested Rename needs Mica Pro.

tips: Run it on the top frame of a screen rather than on many small groups.
Add naming rules first, such as how icons should be named, for consistent results.
Leave the board open until names finish; closing it cancels the rest.

features.title: AI 이름 지정 스타일
features.summary: AI가 지정하는 이름의 길이, 형식, 사용자 지정 이름 지정 규칙을 선택합니다.
steps: 설정 → 캔버스 → AI 레이어 이름을 엽니다.
이름 길이로 간결하게, 표준 또는 자세하게를 선택합니다.
이름 형식으로 단어마다 첫 글자 대문자, 첫 글자만 대문자, camelCase 또는 kebab-case 등을 선택합니다. 선택하면 예시가 업데이트됩니다.
이름 지정 규칙을 입력합니다. 예: 아이콘 이름은 “Icon / 이름” 형식으로 지정.

faq.a: Apple Intelligence가 최대한 따르려고 합니다. 길이와 형식은 항상 적용됩니다.
아니요. 이 기기의 환경설정입니다.

features.why: Teams have their own naming conventions. AI naming style makes Rename with AI and AI Nested Rename follow yours: how long names are, how they're written, and your own rules.
uses: Get kebab-case names that match your code.
Keep names to one or two words for compact layer lists.
Ask for “Icon / Name” paths for icons and CTA for main buttons.

details.text: Concise (1–2 words, up to 24 characters), Standard (1–4 words, 40 characters, the default) or Descriptive (2–6 words, 60 characters).

Automatic (the default: Title Case in English, the language's own rules otherwise), Title Case, Sentence case, lowercase, camelCase, PascalCase, kebab-case or snake_case. Slash paths keep their parts, and words such as iPhone keep their capitals.
Previews the chosen format on a sample name.
Free text, up to 500 characters. Apple Intelligence follows the rules on a best-effort basis; rule-based names ignore them.
Restores Standard, Automatic and empty rules.
Preferences on this device. They aren't saved with boards.

tips: Length and format are always applied, so use them for anything that must be exact.
Write rules as short, concrete examples, one per sentence.
Mention the layer type in each rule, such as icons or buttons, so it's applied to the right layers.

features.title: 기기 내 어시스트
features.summary: 기기를 벗어나지 않고 레이어 이름을 제안하고, 대체 텍스트를 생성하고, 플레이스홀더 콘텐츠를 채웁니다.
steps: 레이어를 선택하고 디자인 도구 → 어시스트를 엽니다.
레이어 이름 제안, 대체 텍스트 생성 또는 플레이스홀더 콘텐츠 채우기를 선택합니다.
결과를 검토합니다. 각 어시스트는 한 번의 실행 취소 단계입니다.

faq.a: 예. Apple Intelligence가 없어도 규칙 기반 대체 방식으로 작동합니다.
메모 탭에 있는 레이어의 손쉬운 사용 레이블에 들어갑니다.

features.why: Small chores slow down design work: naming layers, writing alt text, filling mockups with copy. Assists do them in one step on your device, and work offline.
uses: Write accessibility labels for every image on a page.
Fill a wireframe's text layers with realistic copy.
Give a selection of layers quick descriptive names.

details.text: In Design Tools, and in the canvas selection menu. Needs a selection.
Names up to 200 selected layers and frame contents in one pass.
For up to 50 selected images. Recognizes subjects and text in the image on device and writes the result into the layer's accessibility label.
Replaces the text of up to 100 selected text layers and sticky notes with copy that suits each layer's name and length.
Apple's on-device model polishes results where it's available. Rule-based fallbacks keep every assist working offline, and nothing leaves your device.
Each assist is one undo step. Locked layers aren't changed.
Assists need Mica Pro.

tips: Name text layers by role (title, button, name) before Fill Placeholder Content for better copy.
Review generated alt text and edit it in the Notes tab; describe purpose, not only content.
Use Rename with AI for context-aware names, and Suggest Layer Names for a quick batch.

features.title: 주석 및 스케치
features.summary: Apple Pencil, 손가락 또는 마우스로 레퍼런스 위에 그리고, 강조하고, 지웁니다.
steps: Pencil 팔레트를 열고 주석 또는 강조를 선택합니다.
속성에서 두께와 색상을 설정합니다. 속성이 닫혀 있으면 떠 있는 스타일 패널이 나타납니다.
캔버스에 그립니다. 획을 지우려면 지우개를, 선택하려면 올가미를 사용합니다.
다시 선택하려면 포인터를 선택합니다.

faq.a: 예. 그리기 전에 보드 탐색기에서 레이어를 선택합니다.
예. 부드러운 패스로 변환을 선택하거나, 채워진 도형을 만들려면 선 윤곽선 만들기를 선택합니다.

features.why: Marking up a reference is often faster than describing it. Annotate lets you draw, highlight and erase directly on the board, with Apple Pencil, a finger, a mouse or a trackpad.
uses: Circle details on a reference to discuss with a client.
Highlight the parts of a photo you want to reuse.
Sketch a quick layout idea over a screenshot.

details.text: A pen stroke. Width from 1 to 400, default 4.
A translucent highlighter stroke. Width from 8 to 100, default 22.
Removes ink strokes.
Selects strokes. With Figma Keyboard Shortcuts on, Lasso is ⇧L.
With an ink tool active, the Selected tab or inspector shows width and color. The floating style panel appears only when the sidebar is closed.
Returns to selecting and moving.

details.term: Convert to Smooth Path and Outline Stroke
details.text: Turn a sketch into an editable path, or a stroke into a filled shape.
Pencil markup is always available, also without Mica Pro.

tips: Draw annotations on their own layer so you can hide them before presenting or exporting.
Use Highlight rather than a thick pen so the reference stays readable.
Use a bright color that doesn't appear in the reference.

hero.alt: Circling and marking up references with Apple Pencil on iPad

features.title: 브러시 도구
features.summary: Apple Pencil, 손가락 또는 마우스로 질감 있는 획을 칠합니다. 획 하나하나가 별도의 레이어가 됩니다.
steps: 도구 독의 그리기 도구 메뉴나 Pencil 팔레트에서 브러시를 선택합니다.
페인트, 드라이 브러시, 수채화, 분필 중에서 스타일을 고릅니다. 두께와 색상은 속성 또는 떠 있는 스타일 패널에서 설정합니다.
캔버스에 칠합니다. 브러시 두께와 같은 크기의 원이 포인터나 Apple Pencil을 따라 표시됩니다.
각 획은 브러시 획 레이어가 되며, 이동, 회전, 크기 조절, 색상 변경, 실행 취소를 할 수 있습니다.

faq.a: 아니요. 각 획은 칠할 때의 스타일을 유지합니다.

faq.q: 브러시 획이 무료 플랜의 항목 수에 포함됩니까?
faq.a: 아니요. 주석 획과 마찬가지로 마크업으로 취급됩니다.

features.why: Annotate draws clean ink; the Brush tool adds the look of real paint. Every stroke is its own layer, so painted marks can be moved, recolored and arranged like any other design element.
uses: Paint a brush swash behind a headline.
Add watercolor washes to a moodboard.
Sketch chalky hand-drawn marks over references.
Make textured underlines and highlights for a poster.

details.text: In the tool dock's Drawing tools menu (Annotate, Highlight, Brush, Eraser) and the Pencil palettes. Works with Apple Pencil, touch and the mouse. Each stroke, from pen-down to lift, becomes one Brush Stroke layer.

Paint (default: smooth body, soft streaks), Dry Brush (strong bristles, ragged ends), Watercolor (translucent washes with darker edges) and Chalk (grainy, broken strands). Shown in the floating style panel, the iPhone style palette and Properties while Brush is active.
Brush has its own width (4–400, default 48) and color (default blue), separate from Annotate and Highlight. The style, width and color are remembered on the device.
A ring as wide as the stroke follows the pointer or Apple Pencil hover while Annotate, Highlight or Brush is active.
Move, rotate, resize, recolor, duplicate, erase and undo strokes like any layer. Each stroke keeps its own style and texture when moved.
Like Annotate, brush strokes are markup and don't count toward the free-tier item limit.

tips: Use one long confident stroke for swashes; each lift starts a new layer.
Group related strokes so you can move them together.
Try Watercolor with a light color and overlap strokes for depth.
Hover with Apple Pencil to see the brush size before you paint.

features.title: Apple Pencil 사용 시 손가락으로 이동하기
features.summary: Apple Pencil로 그릴 때는 한 손가락이 그리는 대신 캔버스를 이동합니다.
steps: 그리기 도구에서 Apple Pencil로 한 번 그립니다. 그 이후로는 한 손가락으로 캔버스를 이동합니다.
iPadOS 설정 → Apple Pencil에서 Apple Pencil로만 그리기가 켜져 있으면 한 손가락은 항상 이동에 사용됩니다.
Pencil이 없으면 한 손가락으로 평소처럼 그립니다.
이동 중에 손바닥이 닿으면 Pencil이 이동을 취소합니다.

faq.a: iPadOS는 Pencil을 사용하기 전까지 페어링된 Pencil을 알려 주지 않습니다. 먼저 Pencil로 한 획을 그리십시오.
Apple Pencil이 지원되는 모든 곳에 적용됩니다.

features.why: When Apple Pencil draws, your finger is free to move the canvas, the way it works in drawing apps. You can pan without switching tools.
uses: Draw with the Pencil and push the canvas with one finger.
Mark up a large board without going back to the Pointer tool.

details.text: Once Apple Pencil has drawn in this session, one finger pans in drawing tools. Before that, one finger draws.
If this iPadOS setting is on, one finger always pans in drawing tools.
A finger is ignored while the Pencil is drawing.
If the Pencil lands while a finger is panning, the pan stops, so a resting palm doesn't move the canvas.
iPadOS can't report a paired Pencil until it's used, so draw one stroke first.

tips: Draw a short stroke when you start, so finger panning turns on.
Turn on Only Draw with Apple Pencil in iPadOS Settings if you always draw with the Pencil.
If a palm keeps moving the canvas, start each stroke with the Pencil before resting your hand.

features.title: 측정
features.summary: 레퍼런스의 거리와 레이어 사이의 간격을 측정합니다.
steps: Pencil 팔레트에서 측정을 선택하고 레퍼런스를 가로질러 드래그하면 거리가 표시됩니다.
레이어 사이를 측정하려면 레이어 하나를 선택하고 Option을 누른 채 다른 레이어를 가리킵니다.
설정 → 캔버스 → 편집에서 선택 항목 크기 보기를 켜면 모든 선택 항목에 크기 배지가 표시됩니다.

faq.a: 인스펙터와 같은 단위인 캔버스 포인트를 사용합니다.
Mac 또는 iPad에서 키보드와 포인터가 필요합니다.

features.why: Proportions and spacing are easier to check with numbers. Measure reads distances on references and the gaps between layers in canvas points.
uses: Compare a figure's head length to its height on a reference.
Check the gap between two cards before aligning them.
Read a layer's inset inside its frame.

details.text: Drag across the canvas. A readout shows the distance in points and the angle in degrees.

Select a layer, hold Option and point at another to see edge-to-edge gaps. When one contains the other, it shows the insets; when they overlap, the edge offsets. Needs a keyboard and pointer, on Mac or iPad.
In Settings → Canvas → Editing. Shows a size badge on every selection. On by default.
In Settings → Canvas → Editing, or ⌃R to show or hide rulers.

tips: Hold Option while dragging to check spacing without leaving the Pointer tool.
Measure along a line and read the angle to check perspective lines.
Units are canvas points, the same as the inspector, so you can type the value straight in.

features.title: 색상 팔레트
features.summary: 레퍼런스에서 6색 또는 12색 팔레트를 추출하거나 정확한 영역을 샘플링합니다.
steps: 레퍼런스를 선택하고 색상 팔레트를 선택합니다.
6색 또는 12색을 선택합니다. Mica가 레퍼런스 옆에 팔레트를 배치합니다.
특정 영역을 샘플링하려면 Pencil 팔레트에서 팔레트 추출 영역을 선택하고 원하는 부분 위로 드래그합니다.
정확한 색상 하나를 고르려면 색상(스포이드)을 사용합니다.

faq.q: 팔레트 색상을 스타일로 저장할 수 있습니까?
faq.a: 예. 선택 항목 색상을 사용하여 색상을 색상 스타일로 만듭니다.
예. 에셋을 주요 색상으로 필터링합니다.

features.why: Pulling colors from references by hand is slow and inexact. Palettes extract the main colors from an image, or from just the part you circle.
uses: Build a color scheme from a mood board photo.
Sample the sky in a painting separately from the foreground.
Pick one exact color from a screenshot.

details.text: Select one or more images and choose 6 Colors or 12 Colors. A palette appears beside each reference.
In the Pencil palette. Circle an image area; the palette is made when the path closes. Choose 6 or 12 colors in the tool's menu.
The eyedropper. Picks one exact color.
Share a selected palette as an image. Only the palette artwork is included; notes, tags and source links stay in Mica.
Palette generation needs Mica Pro. On the free plan, each palette also counts toward the item limit.

tips: Use 6 colors for a quick scheme and 12 for subtle shifts in skin tones or skies.
Use Palette Area on busy images so background colors don't skew the result.
Turn colors you'll reuse into color styles with Selection Colors.

hero.alt: Color palettes generated from three reference photos

features.title: 흑백, 포스터화 및 격자
features.summary: 원본 파일을 변경하지 않고 명암과 구도를 연구합니다.
steps: 레퍼런스를 선택하고 아트 스터디를 열거나 인스펙터의 스터디 섹션을 사용합니다.
흑백을 켜서 명암을 확인합니다.
포스터화를 2, 3, 4 또는 6단계로 추가하여 명암을 단순화합니다.
가로로 뒤집기 또는 세로로 뒤집기로 드로잉 오류를 찾고, 레퍼런스 격자를 추가하여 비율을 옮겨 그립니다.

faq.a: 아니요. 스터디 보기는 원본을 변경하지 않습니다.
예. 모든 이미지를 자르고, 뒤집고, 회전하고, 크기를 조절하고, 불투명도를 변경할 수 있습니다.

features.why: Value and composition matter more than color when you learn from a reference. Study views simplify the image without changing the original file.
uses: Check a painting's values in grayscale.
Reduce a photo to 3 values for a notan sketch.
Flip a reference to spot drawing errors.
Lay a transfer grid over a reference to copy proportions.

details.text: In the inspector: Grayscale, Flip H, Flip V and Posterize.
Off, 2, 3, 4 or 6 values.
Splits the image into 2 to 8 value bands. In Artist Study, select a band and choose None, Isolate, Accent or Mask to highlight it, and turn on Outline Value Masses.
A full-screen workspace with Compare modes: Original, Study, Side by Side, Vertical Split, Horizontal Split, Wipe and Flicker. Flicker pauses when Reduce Motion is on.
Shows the value spread. Balance Bands to Image fits the bands to it. Available when the original is on this device.
Presets Transfer, Thirds and Golden. Columns and rows from 2 to 32, Centerlines, Diagonals and Opacity.
Saves the study view as an image.

tips: Start with 3 values to see the big shapes, then add more.
Flip the reference every so often; errors you've stopped seeing become obvious.
Use Wipe to compare the study with the original at the same spot.
Match the grid's columns and rows to the grid on your paper.

features.title: GIF, 비디오 및 PDF
features.summary: 애니메이션과 비디오를 프레임 단위로 살펴보고, 필요한 프레임이나 페이지를 추출합니다.
steps: GIF 또는 WebP를 선택하고 애니메이션 재생을 선택하거나, 타임라인에서 프레임 단위로 이동합니다.
비디오를 선택하고 비디오 재생을 선택합니다. 정밀하게 이동하며 프레임을 캔버스에 저장합니다.
PDF를 선택하고 PDF 페이지 둘러보기를 선택하여 필요한 페이지만 추가합니다.

faq.a: 예. 저장한 프레임은 보드에서 정지 이미지가 됩니다.
아니요. 스크린샷 내보내기는 정지 콘텐츠만 지원합니다.

features.why: Animation and video references are hard to learn from at full speed. Mica lets you slow them down, step frame by frame, and keep the frames you need.
uses: Study a walk cycle frame by frame from a GIF.
Save key poses from a video as stills on the board.
Place only the pages you need from a long PDF.

details.text: For GIF and WebP. Shows the frame count and length, steps frame by frame, and plays at 0.25×, 0.5×, 1× or 2×. Save Frame adds frames to the canvas.
Steps one frame, or 5 seconds back or forward. Speeds 0.25× to 2×. Mute and full screen.
Adds the exact frame to the canvas as a still image.
Uses the current video frame as the thumbnail for that placement.
Select pages, or All Pages, and choose Add to Canvas. Place them as a Grid, Row or Column.

tips: Slow to 0.25× to find the frame you want, then step one frame at a time.
Save several key frames at once and arrange them in a row to compare poses.
Add only the PDF pages you need; it keeps the board light.

hero.alt: Stepping through a video and saving frames to the board on Mac

features.title: 시간 제한 스터디
features.summary: 레퍼런스를 정해진 시간 간격으로 보며 제스처 드로잉과 인체 드로잉을 연습합니다.
steps: 스터디할 레퍼런스를 선택하거나, 아무것도 선택하지 않으면 페이지의 모든 레퍼런스가 사용됩니다.
시간 제한 스터디를 선택합니다. Mica가 프레젠테이션 모드를 열고 타이머를 시작합니다.
타이머 메뉴를 열어 간격을 고르고 섞기를 켜거나 끕니다.
진행 막대가 레퍼런스마다 남은 시간을 표시합니다. 같은 메뉴에서 세션을 중단합니다.

faq.a: 아니요. 레퍼런스를 보여 주기만 합니다.
10초입니다. 타이머 메뉴에서 10초, 30초, 1분, 2분, 5분을 선택할 수 있습니다.

features.why: Gesture and figure drawing practice works best with a timer that moves on for you. Timed study shows your references one by one at a fixed interval.
uses: Do 30-second gesture drawings from a pose board.
Warm up with a shuffled set of references.
Run longer 5-minute studies from a selection.

details.text: Opens presentation mode and starts the timer with the selected references, or every reference on the page when nothing is selected.
The timer menu offers 10 Seconds, 30 Seconds, 1 Minute, 2 Minutes and 5 Minutes. The default is 1 Minute.
Shows references in random order. Off by default.
Pause holds the current reference; Resume continues the countdown.
In the timer menu. Ends the timed session.
Move to the previous or next reference.

tips: Start with short intervals to loosen up, then move to longer ones.
Turn on Shuffle so you can't anticipate the next pose.
Collect references on their own page for each kind of study.

features.title: 작업 옆에 레퍼런스 띄우기
features.summary: 다른 앱에서 그리는 동안에도 레퍼런스를 계속 볼 수 있습니다.
steps: Mac에서는 윈도우 → 레퍼런스 창(⌥⌘R)을 선택합니다. 다른 앱 위에 떠 있습니다.
iPhone 및 iPad에서는 레퍼런스를 선택하고 화면 속 화면을 선택합니다.
iPad에서는 Split View나 스테이지 매니저를 사용하여 드로잉 앱 옆에 Mica를 엽니다.
전체 화면 프레젠테이션 모드를 사용하려면 프레젠테이션 시작을 선택하고, 집중하려면 UI를 가립니다.

faq.a: 아니요. 읽기 전용이므로 실수로 항목을 옮길 일이 없습니다.
Mica의 잠금을 해제한 후에만 표시됩니다.

features.why: You draw in one app and look at references in another. Mica keeps references visible above or beside your work, read-only, so you never move them by accident.
uses: Float a reference board over Photoshop or a 3D app on Mac.
Keep a reference in Picture in Picture over Procreate on iPad.
Present references full screen on a second display.

details.text: Mac only, in the Window menu. A floating window above other apps. Pick a board to keep on top; it's read-only.
Mac. In Settings → General. A menu-bar target for dropping references onto a board from any app, with a shortcut to the Reference Window.

iPhone and iPad. Select references and choose Picture in Picture. The window keeps floating after you leave Mica. Skip forward or back moves between references; play advances at the timed-study interval.
On iPad, open Mica beside your drawing app.
Full-screen presentation of the page's references. From there you can open a floating reference, the Reference Window, Artist Study or Timed Study.
Private boards don't appear until you unlock Mica. App lock also covers the Reference Window.

tips: Make a small board of only the references for the current piece, and pin that one.
Use Picture in Picture with play for a hands-free reference slideshow.
On Mac, size the Reference Window small and park it in a corner of your drawing app.

features.title: Apple Vision Pro에서 Mica 사용하기
features.summary: 공간 작업 환경에서 보드를 편집하고, 레퍼런스 보드를 방의 벽에 고정합니다.
steps: 보드를 엽니다. 탐색기, 인스펙터, 도구가 캔버스 주위에 배치됩니다.
프레젠테이션 시작을 선택하고 테두리 없는 보드, 떠 있는 보드 또는 벽을 고릅니다.
벽을 바라보면 보드가 고정됩니다. 원하면 물리적 크기를 설정하고 컨트롤을 가립니다.
각각 고유한 페이지나 보드를 표시하는 방 보드를 최대 6개까지 추가합니다. 보드를 제거하려면 보드 위의 닫기 버튼을 사용합니다.

faq.a: 아니요. 배치는 세션 동안만 유지되며 보드를 변경하지 않습니다.
예. 최대 8K 레퍼런스를 확대/축소, 이동, 이전/다음으로 살펴볼 수 있습니다.

features.why: Apple Vision Pro gives you more room than any screen. Mica lets you edit boards spatially and pin references to the walls around you, life-size if you like.
uses: Pin mood boards to the walls of your studio while you work.
Show a page at real size on a wall to judge scale.
Keep a borderless board of references beside another app.
Look at a 3D model reference next to your board.

details.text: The navigator sits on the left, the inspector on the right and the tool dock at the bottom. Look and pinch to select. A two-hand pinch on the selection scales and rotates it; elsewhere it zooms the canvas.
The hand button on the dock explains look and pinch, pinch and drag, two-hand gestures, double-pinch to edit text, pinch and hold for the layer menu, and dragging in from other apps.
Borderless Board shows references only, beside other apps. Floating Board places them in your room. Anchor to Wall uses a detected vertical surface; it needs World Sensing access.
Smaller and Larger set the physical size, Hide Controls hides them, Place Here anchors to the wall, Keep Floating leaves it in the air, and Open Editor returns to editing.
Crop a room board to part of the page: drag a corner to resize, drag inside to look around, pinch to zoom. Fill Wall stretches the frame across the wall. Whole Board removes the crop.
Show up to 6 room boards at once, each with any page of this or another board. Each has its own close button.
Pinch a reference to inspect it up to 8K, with zoom, pan, Previous Reference and Next Reference.
Open in New Window shows a board in its own window. Drag Out drags the selection into another app as a PNG.
Opens a USDZ or Reality file in a volume beside your board. Drag to turn it, use both hands to resize, and Reset View. Needs Mica Pro.
Room placement lasts for the session and never changes the board.

tips: Allow World Sensing access the first time so boards can anchor to walls.
If a board is too big for a wall, choose Frame and show only the part you need.
Use Hide Controls for an uncluttered room once boards are placed.
Put different pages on different walls with Add Board instead of making copies.

hero.alt: A Mica board placed on a living-room wall in Apple Vision Pro

features.title: 캔버스 설정
features.summary: 새 보드의 기본값, 확대/축소 속도, 맞추기, 작업 공간 레이아웃, 슈퍼 레이아웃을 설정합니다.
steps: 설정(Mac에서는 ⌘,)을 열고 캔버스를 선택합니다.
기본값에서 새 보드의 캔버스 배경, 격자, 기본 보기를 선택합니다.
탐색에서 트랙패드 확대/축소 속도와 스크롤 확대/축소 속도를 조절합니다.
편집에서 맞추기, 눈금자, 가이드, 레이아웃 격자, 선택 항목 크기 배지를 설정합니다.
인스펙터를 왼쪽 사이드바에 두려면 단일 사이드바를 켜고, 섹션 순서를 변경한 후 되돌리려면 인스펙터 레이아웃 재설정을 사용합니다.

faq.q: 인스펙터 섹션의 순서를 변경할 수 있습니까?
faq.a: 예. 섹션 제목을 드래그하여 순서를 변경하거나, 제목을 클릭하여 접습니다.

faq.q: AI 이름 지정 옵션은 어디에 있습니까?
faq.a: 설정 → 캔버스 → AI 레이어 이름에 있습니다.

features.why: Canvas settings set how new boards start and how the canvas feels to work in. Change them once, and every board follows.
uses: Make new boards start on a dark background with a line grid.
Slow down trackpad zoom for precise work.
Use Figma's keyboard shortcuts.
Keep the inspector in one sidebar on a small screen.

details.text: Off-White, White, Pure Black, Graphite, Paper, Custom, and on Vision Pro System Glass. White is the default, and System Glass on Vision Pro.

details.term: Default Canvas Grid and Default View
details.text: The grid and the view (Infinite Canvas, Grid or List) for new boards.
Thumbnail Quality: Performance, Balanced (default) or High Quality. Minimap: Always Show, Show While Navigating (default) or Hidden.
10% to 150%, default 45%. Lower values zoom more slowly.
For the mouse wheel and Option- or Command-scrolling. 25% to 300%, default 150%. Reset Zoom Speed restores both.

Snap to Grid, Snap to Item Edges, Snap to Pixel Grid, Show Rulers, Show Guides, Show Layout Grids, Show Selection Size and Rounded Image Corners. Hold Shift to move along one axis, Control to ignore snapping.

details.term: Single Sidebar and Reset Inspector Layout

Uses Figma's keys where Mica's differ: L draws a line, ⇧L opens the lasso, ⌥⌘O outlines strokes, ⇧H and ⇧V flip, and ⇧⌘H shows or hides the selection.
Infer from Arrangement (on by default) reads direction, gap and padding from the layers. Turn it off to set Direction, Gap and Padding (0 to 256, steps of 4, default 16). First on Top sets stacking.
Name Length, Name Format and Naming Rules for Rename with AI.

tips: Turn on Snap to Pixel Grid for UI design so edges stay crisp.
Lower Trackpad zoom speed if zooming feels jumpy on a large trackpad.
Turn on Figma Keyboard Shortcuts if you switch between Mica and Figma every day.
Canvas defaults apply only to boards you create afterwards.

features.title: 데이터, 동기화 및 백업 설정
features.summary: iCloud 상태를 확인하고 가져오기, 내보내기, 빠른 이미지 내보내기, 백업 옵션을 선택합니다.
steps: 설정을 열고 데이터를 선택합니다.
상단에서 iCloud 상태를 확인합니다.
가져오기 옵션으로 가져올 때 중복 감지와 원본 파일 이름 유지를 선택합니다.
내보내기 옵션과 빠른 이미지 내보내기 기본값을 선택합니다.
이 기기에 각 보드의 최근 버전을 보관하려면 보드 버전 저장을 켭니다.

faq.q: iCloud를 시작할 수 없으면 어떻게 됩니까?
faq.a: 라이브러리는 로컬에서 계속 사용할 수 있습니다. Mica를 종료했다가 다시 열어 재시도하십시오.
보드를 닫을 때 저장된 각 보드의 최근 버전이 보관됩니다. 이름 있는 버전은 삭제되지 않습니다.

features.why: Data settings decide how files come in and go out, and how your boards are backed up on this device. Check them once when you set up Mica.
uses: Avoid duplicate copies when you import the same photo twice.
Start Quick Image Export at 2x every time.
Restore an earlier version of a board after a mistake.

details.text: Shows iCloud Enabled, Local only, Sign in to iCloud to sync, or iCloud unavailable — working locally. If iCloud can't start, your library stays available locally.
Reuses a file you already have instead of storing it again. On by default.
On by default.
Include Notes in Exports (on by default) and Strip Metadata on Export (off by default).
Default Scale (1x, 2x, 3x or 4x; 1x by default) and Ignore Overlapping Layers (off by default).
Keeps the last 30 versions of each board on this device, saved when you close it. On by default. Restore one from the board's long-press menu; restoring creates a new board and never overwrites.

tips: Keep Detect Duplicates on to save storage and iCloud space.
Keep Save Board Versions on; restoring makes a copy, so it's safe to try.
Board versions stay on this device; export a .refboard for a backup you can move.

features.title: 개인정보 보호 및 앱 잠금
features.summary: Mica를 잠그고, 잠금을 해제할 때까지 비공개 보드, 폴더, 페이지, 레이어를 가립니다.
steps: 설정 → 개인정보 보호를 열고 실행 시 앱 잠금을 켭니다.
잠금 해제 방법으로 Face ID, Touch ID, Optic ID 또는 암호를 선택하고, 다시 잠글 시점을 선택합니다.
보드나 폴더를 길게 누르고 비공개로 전환을 선택합니다.
비공개 항목은 잠금을 해제할 때까지 흐리게 표시되며, 제한 시간이 지나면 다시 잠깁니다.

faq.a: 아니요. 비공개 콘텐츠는 Spotlight와 내보내기에서 제외됩니다.
예. Mac에서는 앱 잠금이 레퍼런스 창, 빠른 드롭, 설정에도 적용됩니다.

features.why: Some boards are personal or under NDA. App lock and private content keep them hidden from anyone who picks up your device, and out of exports, Spotlight and menus.
uses: Lock Mica on a shared iPad.
Keep a client's unreleased work private in a public library.
Hide one private page or layer inside an otherwise shareable board.

details.text: Asks you to unlock when Mica opens. Off by default.
Face ID, Touch ID or Optic ID (whichever your device has), Passcode, or Passcode plus biometrics. The passcode is a 6-digit PIN; Set Passcode, Change Passcode and Remove Passcode manage it.
Immediately (default), After 1 Minute, After 5 Minutes, After 15 Minutes or After 1 Hour.
On boards and folders in the library, and on layers in the Layers panel. Pages can be private too. Private items stay blurred until you unlock, and relock after the timeout.
Private and hidden content is left out of exports unless you unlock and turn on Include Private Content. Unlock before exporting a .refboard with private content.
App lock also covers the Reference Window, Quick Drop and Settings. The Dock menu never lists private or trashed boards, and shows Unlock Mica to See Boards while locked.

tips: Choose Passcode plus biometrics for the strongest lock.
Use a short Lock After time on shared devices.
Make a folder private to protect every board inside it at once.
Check the Privacy section of Publication Export before you send files.

features.title: Mica Pro
features.summary: 무료 플랜은 보드 및 항목 제한과 함께 기본 기능을 제공합니다. Mica Pro는 제한을 해제하고 템플릿과 공유 기능을 잠금 해제합니다.
steps: 설정을 열고 Mica Pro 행을 선택합니다.
Mica Pro를 한 번 구입하고 Apple 계정으로 확인합니다. 구독이 아닌 일회성 구입입니다.
새 기기에서 복원하려면 구매 복원을 선택합니다.
평가를 남기려면 설정 → 정보 → Mica 평가하기를 선택합니다.

faq.a: Mica가 어떤 동작에 Pro가 필요한지 알려 줍니다. 삭제되는 항목은 없습니다.

faq.q: 복원 시 구매 항목을 찾을 수 없다고 표시됩니다.
faq.a: Pro를 구입할 때 사용한 Apple 계정으로 로그인했는지 확인하십시오.

features.why: The free plan lets you try Mica with one board. Mica Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription, that removes the limits and unlocks every feature on every device.
uses: Create as many boards, pages and items as you need.
Export, share and import boards.
Use Rename with AI, 3D, templates and Agents (MCP) on Mac.

details.text: One board, one page, up to 12 items, and Pencil markup.

Unlimited boards, pages and items, full canvas editing, Effect Studio, masks and rich text, Rename with AI and assists, 3D, every export format, templates, palettes, .refboard import, sharing, and Agents (MCP) on Mac.
Mica Pro is a single unlock with no subscription. The purchase screen shows the price for your App Store storefront.
Only your 3 oldest boards open. The others show a lock and open the purchase screen. Nothing is deleted, and Pro reopens every board.
In Settings → General. A Pro action also explains which feature needs Pro.
In Settings and on the purchase screen. It reports whether purchases were restored, none were found, or it was cancelled.
In Settings → About.

tips: Restore Purchases on each new device signed in with the same Apple Account.
If restore finds nothing, check which Apple Account you bought Pro with.
Try Mica on the free board first; your work stays when you upgrade.

features.title: Agents and MCP in Mica
features.summary: Mica for Mac includes a local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. When you turn it on, AI agents such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and Codex can read your boards and create or edit them through the same features you use: frames, shapes, text, images, effects, styles, variables, components, prototypes and exports. The server runs inside the Mica app on your Mac, listens only on your Mac, and follows the permissions you set in Settings.

hero.alt: An AI agent connected to Mica over MCP building a dashboard design

features.title: Connect an agent to Mica
features.summary: To connect an agent, you turn on the MCP server in Mica for Mac, then add Mica to your agent's MCP configuration. Mica shows a ready-to-copy setup snippet for each popular client, so in most cases you pick your client, click Copy and paste. This page shows the same snippets, explains each setting, and shows how to check that the connection works.

features.title: Permissions and privacy
features.summary: You decide what agents can do in Mica. Settings → Agents lets you choose which kinds of tools are available, which boards agents can see, whether they can delete or touch locked content, and whether they can download from the web. Private content is never visible to agents, whatever you choose. This page explains each setting, its default, and what an agent sees when a setting stops it.

features.title: Agent workflows
features.summary: These recipes show complete tasks an agent can do in Mica, with the tool calls and arguments it makes. You don't need to type any of this yourself: describe what you want, and a capable agent makes similar calls. The examples help you understand what's possible, write better requests, and follow along in the Activity list. Ids such as FRAME_ID stand for the real ids that earlier calls return.

features.title: Best practices for working with agents
features.summary: Agents do their best work in Mica when they read before they write, build in small sections, and look at what they made. This page covers how to phrase requests, what a good agent session looks like, and how to keep your library and your access token safe.

features.title: Troubleshooting agents and MCP
features.summary: When an agent can't connect to Mica or a tool call fails, the error message usually says exactly which setting or item is involved. This page lists the common messages and problems, what causes them, and how to fix them. You can see recent calls and their errors in the Activity list at the bottom of Settings → Agents.

features.title: Tools
features.summary: Generated from the running server (45 tools). Tools switched off in Settings are hidden from tools/list.

features.title: Properties
features.summary: Keys accepted by update_items / update_page / update_layer / update_board (set) and returned by get_items. Settings objects (type object (…)) appear under settings when read and may be written at the top level or under settings; writes merge into the current value, arrays replace, null clears. See types for each object's JSON.

features.title: Settings types
features.summary: Complete JSON for every settings object, encoded from Mica's own defaults. Writes merge into the current value, so you only send the keys you change; when adding a nested object for the first time, missing keys are filled from these defaults where possible. UUIDs are strings, CGPoint is [x, y], CGSize is [w, h], dates are seconds since 2001-01-01.

features.title: Commands
features.summary: Run with run_command {command, item_ids}. list_commands with item_ids reports availability for a selection.
